proposal.title: Six Minutes of Dry Ocean
proposal.idea: Once each season, an impossible low tide exposes a glowing road across the seabed. A transformed river scout has six minutes to carry dawnfire to a cliffside commune before the sea returns, while giant sea cucumbers are the only creatures that know which parts of the road are about to vanish.

vibe.title: Starwake Scouts
vibe.line: Transformation is a flare fired into weather.
vibe.art_direction: A pearl-armored magical scout running across mirror-wet seabed between black bone arches, luminous sea cucumbers curling along a safe path, with an immense returning wall of ocean on the horizon.

locations.title: The Boneglass Reach
locations.known_for: a seabed road exposed for six minutes at impossible low tide
locations.local_rule: follow the sea cucumbers when the horizon goes silent
locations.best_scene: the returning ocean rises into a vertical wall beyond the last hand-lit beacon
locations.art_direction: Black demonic-bone ribs arch over mirror-bright wet sand, tide pools glow electric blue, and luminous sea cucumbers form a winding trail toward a distant cliff village.

characters.name: Tessa Nunes
characters.role_drive: relight the far reef beacon before the returning sea cuts off the village
characters.carries: a folding prism spear built from salvaged survey technology
characters.complication: her tide-light transformation lasts ninety seconds and attracts every deep-water hunter nearby
characters.look: A serious river scout in weathered field gear transformed into layered pearl-white tide armor, translucent fin-like cape panels streaming behind her, with a compact prism spear locked across her back.

rewards.name: Nightheart Lantern
rewards.grants: stores one burst of moonlight powerful enough to relight a dead beacon
rewards.best_used_when: the coast has gone completely dark
rewards.catch: every nearby shadow keeps moving for a minute after the light is spent
rewards.look: A palm-sized lantern carved from glossy black demonic bone, its cage shaped from curved ribs around a cold violet flame that hangs without a wick.

rewards.name: River-Under-Sea
rewards.grants: reads hidden currents through pressure changes underfoot
rewards.best_used_when: crossing exposed or flooded terrain with no visible trail
rewards.catch: living movement and rushing water feel exactly alike
rewards.look: Concentric pale-blue ripples spread from each footfall across wet sand and bend around invisible channels beneath the surface.

scenarios.title: The Returning Wall
scenarios.setup: In Starwake Scouts at The Boneglass Reach, Tessa Nunes races the final exposed kilometer to relight the commune's last hand-kept mirror beacon as giant sea cucumbers abandon the safe trail, a buried salvage machine tears itself free of the mud, and the returning ocean rises behind her as a vertical wall.
